# Torque specifications for body lift hardware

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Use 10mm bolts with 7/16-inch washers for a 2- by -3-inch lift. [t1483]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Use 10mm-1.25 x 160 Grade 8 bolts with a 3/4 inch hex head for main suspension points.
2. [Partial] Apply 7/16-14 Grade 8 flat washers to distribute load on the frame.

_Procedure reported by [t1483]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/diy-body-lift-parts.21/>_

## Specifications

- **Lift block height**: 2 inches [t1483] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Lift block width**: 3 inches [t1483] ([Unverified] single report)
